entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-05-14
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Add support for extensions to Object Browser #78581
  • Add support for extensions to SyntaxGenerator APIs #78580
  • Need to rationalize our MSBuild package strategy #78575
    Next
  • multiple values for capitalization in .editorconfig no longer works since VS 17.14.0 #78574
  • `extension` block doesn't allow `extern` #78572

Closed

  • EnC: Rude edits not reported when file is added by Generate from Usage #32494
    Backlog
  • [API proposal]: Add `GetSpeculativeForEachInfo` #74998
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Add a reference to the tracking bug for a workaround #78582
    Area-IDE
  • Remove localized strings from Collections source package #78576
    Area-IDE

Merged

  • Support more consumption scenarios for unary extension operators #78570
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Move SpecializedCollections to Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Collections namespace #78466
    Area-Compilers, untriaged, VSCode, Next
  • Fix MoveType to create debuggable documents #78554
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Update XAML EA to use DocumentUri instead of System.Uri #78555
    Area-IDE, Next
  • Add Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Extensions package #78388
    Area-IDE, untriaged, VSCode, Next
  • Unset CompilerType from Csc #78483
    Area-Compilers, untriaged, Next
  • Extensions: pattern-based constructs #78480
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, untriaged, Next

Updated

  • Fix embedded language classification inside multi-line string #78588
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Fixes issues with Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Extensions source package #78587
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Reduce duplicated FileUtilities.GetFileTimeStamp calls #78321
    Area-IDE, untriaged
  • Give .NET Framework build task in sdk different identity #78584
    Area-Compilers
  • Track used assemblies of data section string literals #78552
    Area-Compilers, Feature - String Literals in Data Section as UTF8
  • Delete copy of System.IO.Hashing sources #78357
    Area-Compilers, untriaged
  • Fix debugging of build tasks #78271

  • Backport copilot text change analysis to 17.14 #78498
